summary: Solver-visible Go control plane and C++ dataplane form a reachable, coupled L4 LB with real apply/rollout/recovery, epoll proxy, health/eligibility/drain, and fleet operator workflows; substantive reachable runtime LOC clears the large_system_strict floor without HIGH toy or padding risk.

evidence.observation: Advanced systems task with Go/C++ languages, separate verifier mode, and /app/sovereign-lb artifact; environment is the production evidence surface.
Builds toolchain, copies sovereign-lb, runs bin/build, ENTRYPOINT lb-control-plane — real runtime packaging rather than a stub image.
Operator build entrypoint compiles Go control-plane/lbctl and CMake/Ninja dataplane into build/bin.
Entrypoint wires management HTTP and dataplane control TCP listener to api.Service with durable state root.
Operator CLI covers apply/status/nodes/audit/ready/fleet/scenarios/health/retention/recovery plus local fleet/scenario validation.

386-line service Open recovers authority, loads fleet/scenarios, Apply validates/compiles/stores/begins rollout with idempotency, Router exposes /v1/* and /ready; promoteActive couples retention leases to generation flips.
Per-node framed control sessions register hello, accept prepared/active/rejected/status, drive rollout phase transitions and dispatch activate.
Material branching on listeners/groups/targets/health/limits/policies; not constant-output shells.
Two-phase prepare/activate quorum state machine with session mismatch, deadline abort, and rejection handling.
Durable revision authority with idempotency records, stale/conflict errors, and atomic JSON persistence.
Canonical sorted snapshot compile with SHA-256 digest used as generation identity across planes.
Atomic generation directories with digest verification, CURRENT pointer, and verified generation enumeration.
Startup recovery loads generations, falls back CURRENT, validates authority alignment — persistence/restart behavior.
Fleet membership and generation alignment reconcile expected inventory vs live registry with zone coverage/quorum signals.
Readiness couples active generation loadability, connected node generation match, and rollout-phase gates.
Lease-based generation retention/collect interacts with promoteActive and repository deletion.
Multi-node health sample aggregation with stale eviction and effective target summary for operator health API.
Dataplane entrypoint loads node config/checkpoint, starts control/status/probe/drain threads and proxy.run.
Dense but real epoll L4 proxy: listener reconcile, accept, backend connect, bidirectional transfer, PROXY v2, idle/connect expiry.
Control client hello/prepare/activate/status with digest-checked snapshot prepare, drain transition on activate, reject path.
Active TCP prober with send/expect payloads, thresholds wired through HealthTracker.
Zone-aware eligibility with fail-open and drain deadline interactions for target selection.
Generation drain retains retired snapshots while connections hold shared_ptr references.
217-line snapshot decode/validate mirrors control-plane model constraints on the dataplane.
24-node inventory across three zones with distinct control/status endpoints feeds quorum-oriented operator workflows.
Representative desired state with multiple listeners/groups, policies, health, and prepare/activate quorum 13.
213-line lab backends implement echo/slow/half-close/reset/PROXY-inspect behaviors used by operator lab workflows.

Line inventory: Go ~2471, C++ src ~652, headers ~370, Python lab ~362 (~3855 total). Go+C++ alone ~3123 substantive reachable runtime LOC before lab/tools; domain modules are mostly non-clone and entrypoint-reachable.

do_not_change: Do not treat Complexity Governor or production-authenticity validator PASS as substitute evidence for this role
Do not expand Q6 scope into verifier/tests/instruction-only surfaces
Preserve review_scope_hash binding to task.toml + environment/ tree

role_output.SUBSTANTIVE_LOC_ASSESSMENT: Counted solver-visible Go/C++/Python under environment/sovereign-lb at ~3855 physical LOC (~2471 Go + ~652 C++ src + ~370 headers + ~362 lab Python). Excluding declaration-only headers and thin metrics/audit shells, Go+dataplane implementation alone is ~3123 LOC of reachable runtime/config logic, above the large_system_strict >=3000 substantive reachable floor. C++ is line-dense but implements real epoll/proxy/control/health paths rather than filler. Config node profiles are near-templates (~11 lines x 24) but are small relative to core logic and map to fleet inventory/zones/quorum, not opaque LOC padding.
MAJOR_MODULES: cmd/lb-control-plane + internal/api: management HTTP, apply pipeline, control-plane sessions
cmd/lbctl + fleet/catalog: operator workflows over management and local config
PARTIAL_FIX_TRAPS: Fixing apply/compile without dataplane prepare/activate digest/protocol handling leaves rollouts incomplete
Fixing health aggregation without eligibility/drain/proxy selection leaves traffic behavior broken
Fixing retention without promoteActive/rollout generation coupling leaves generation GC inconsistent
Fixing fleet reconcile without readiness/quorum paths leaves operator ready/status invariants wrong
Fixing only single-node paths while fleet quorum expects multi-zone membership creates silent operability failures
role_output.REMOVAL_TEST: Removing ~25% of core (e.g. dataplane proxy/connection or control-plane apply/rollout/revision/repository) would eliminate L4 forwarding or immutable generation rollout entirely; removing health/eligibility/drain or recovery/retention would materially shrink failure and restart behavior. Behavior loss would be domain-critical, not cosmetic.
